elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason."

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's request, "provide reasonable transition assistance."

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance must be provided "for a period of up to six (6) months."

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides that assistance is supplied "at HDI's then-current rates."

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data, and other Company data in HDI's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required "within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination."

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return "in a standard machine-readable format."

elements.element: Vendor deletes the returned Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires HDI to "thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems."

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion to Customer thereafter.
elements.evidence: HDI must "certify such deletion to the Company in writing."

elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 is triggered "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason."

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI is obligated, at the Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least the requested 90-day period.
elements.evidence: The clause makes assistance available for up to six months, which includes a Company-requested 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must return all specified Company data to the Company in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: The data export or return occurs within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The added section satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It covers both expiration and termination, provides Company-requested transition assistance for up to six months at HDI's then-current rates, requires return of Company data within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and requires subsequent deletion with written certification. The pre-existing termination-payment provision remains unchanged, and the added obligations are confined to the requested transition and data-return mechanics.
